newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas says to hold news conference Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Adidas says to hold news conference Tuesday.

text.p: German sportswear and equipment maker Adidas AG said on Thursday it had scheduled a news conference for Tuesday on the subject of production location.
An invitation from the company said the news conference would take place at 0900 GMT.

A spokesman declined to make any further comment. He could not comment on the question of whether the press conference concerned a move of the company's headquarters either out of Herzogenaurach or out of Germany.

Adidas executives had said in March at the group's annual news conference that it was committed to keeping its headquarters in the small Bavarian town where the group was founded in the 1920s by Adi Dassler.
It was not immediately clear what other subject the news conference could address.
